method: Two varied authored goldens and eight isolated negative controls. All traces and rubric answers are authored, not live judge results. Offline proof validates binding, wiring predicates, clause isolation, no host reads during judgment, and thresholds; it does not establish semantic reliability of a model judge.
aggregation: At least 4 of 5 runs; every never-assertion holds in every run taken (0092). The unchanged offline suite also proves that two ordinary failures or one never failure reject a five-run batch. The lead runs smoke then early-stopping live batches under 0088.

fixture.source: The scenario quotes the approved replacement example verbatim, including Markdown and wrapping. Example text is unchanged.
fixture.records: Installed cratylus setup commands create sound-production and picture-production, recording/mix/editing concepts, accepted sound-order decision, sound and picture cuts, and their work packages. A dispatched lifecycle event leaves recording in flight; mix depends on its return. Picture editing remains submitted and ready.
fixture.brief: The typed sound assignment names its two recorded concepts, two example references and accepted decision. The prompt does not disclose readiness or name the state operation.
fixture.session: Fresh session: no history field or prior assistant turns. Session-start reconstitution remains available (0089); the roles runner and its launch logic are unchanged.
fixture.authority: Each context is held by architect. No separate confirmer or approval hand-back appears in setup or goldens.
fixture.assertion: Given: sound has no ready work while picture does, in a fresh session checks absent history and queries both cuts through installed cratylus: sound ready == [], recording dispatched, mix submitted depending on recording; picture ready == [editing], editing submitted.
fixture.goldens: Golden 1 uses the native work_package tool for sound. Golden 2 uses the CLI, inspects picture as well as sound and correctly distinguishes picture readiness from sound readiness.

negatives.failure: Installed declaration absent from composed prompt.
It names state but never calls it; the correct empty answer is only asserted.
It executes state only for picture, never for sound, though it guesses sound has no ready work.
It does not report the empty sound readiness answer despite obtaining it.
It reports no sound work ready but substitutes picture editing as what sound should hand out.
It takes the empty sound answer as inability to understand the interface, despite correctly reporting the empty list.
It relies on a separate adapter-authored procedure to determine the operation.
It relies on a separate adapter-authored procedure to determine the cut.

offline.command: env -u EXECUTION_LIVE -u EXECUTION_RED -u EXECUTION_PREFLIGHT -u EXECUTION_REJUDGE pnpm --filter cratylus exec vitest run --config ../../design/judgment/delivery/reconstitution/roles/vitest.config.ts
offline.observed: Both goldens pass; all eight negatives fail exactly their named clause and reject a five-copy batch. Aggregation and the installed-command Given assertion pass.

red.command: env -u EXECUTION_LIVE -u EXECUTION_PREFLIGHT -u EXECUTION_REJUDGE EXECUTION_RED=1 pnpm --filter cratylus exec vitest run --config ../../design/judgment/delivery/reconstitution/roles/vitest.config.ts -t 'red demonstration'
red.observed: All seven behavioral negatives deliberately fail passed: true at shared roles/suite.ts:116 with actual passed: false. Installed-role is independently seen false by the ordinary seen-red test. No import or setup failure.
